title: DeepSeek Announces Price Reduction for Flash Series Models: Output Cost Reduced to 4 Yuan per Million Tokens
excerpt: According to the announcement of DeepSeek's open platform, the official will implement new pricing starting at 12:00 Beijing Time on September 10, 2026, adjusti
content_html:
According to the announcement of DeepSeek's open platform, the official will implement new pricing starting at 12:00 Beijing Time on September 10, 2026, adjusting the prices of the Flash series models.

After the price adjustment, the cost is 0.02 yuan per 1 million tokens for input cache hit during off-peak hours, 1 yuan per 1 million tokens for input cache miss, and 4 yuan per 1 million tokens for output. During peak hours, the price of each item is twice the off-peak hour price.

All three pricing tiers have decreased, with a price reduction rate of 60% for cache hits

Currently, the Flash series includes two models: deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, and the price change range for these models is consistent.

Specifically, the input (cache hit) price has dropped from 0.05 yuan to 0.02 yuan during off-peak hours, and from 0.10 yuan to 0.04 yuan during peak hours, a decrease of 60%. The input (cache miss) has dropped from 1.5 yuan to 1 yuan during off-peak hours, and from 3.0 yuan to 2 yuan during peak hours, a decrease of 33.33%. Output has dropped from 4.5 yuan to 4 yuan during off-peak hours, and from 9.0 yuan to 8 yuan during peak hours, a decrease of 11.11%.
